name: SplitTextToColumnsNode
label: Split Text to Columns
description: Splits the values of a single text column into multiple columns using a delimiter or fixed-length chunks.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the source column to split.

fields.name: SourceColumn
fields.label: Source Column
fields.description: The name of the text column to split.

fields.name: SplitBy
fields.label: Split By
fields.description: Whether to split by a delimiter or into fixed-length chunks.

selectOptions.label: Delimiter
selectOptions.description: Splits the text on a specified delimiter.

selectOptions.label: Fixed Length
selectOptions.description: Splits the text into fixed-length chunks.

fields.name: Delimiter
fields.label: Delimiter
fields.description: The delimiter used to split the text (used by Delimiter mode).

fields.name: ChunkLength
fields.label: Chunk Length
fields.description: The fixed length of each chunk (used by Fixed Length mode).

fields.name: ColumnPrefix
fields.label: Column Prefix
fields.description: The prefix for the generated columns, e.g., 'Part' produces Part1, Part2, etc.

fields.name: SplitDataTable
fields.label: Split Data Table
fields.description: The data table with the source column split into multiple columns.
